topic: Decide which feature to build next sprint

scenario.topic: Decide which feature to build next sprint
scenario.opening_question: What matters most when choosing our next feature to build: user engagement, development time, or revenue potential?

options.name: Enhanced Search Bar
options.upside: Improves user experience and increases search accuracy.
options.tradeoff: May divert resources from other important features.
options.concern: Dependence on third-party libraries for advanced functionality.

options.name: Personalized Recommendations
options.upside: Increases average order value and enhances user satisfaction.
options.tradeoff: Requires significant data processing and storage.
options.concern: Potential privacy issues with user data collection.

options.name: Real-Time Chat Support
options.upside: Provides immediate assistance to users and improves support efficiency.
options.best_for: Enhancing user support and reducing query resolution time.

options.name: Gamification Module
options.upside: Increases user engagement and encourages desired behaviors.
options.tradeoff: High development cost and time commitment.
options.concern: Risk of over-gamification leading to user fatigue.
options.best_for: Long-term user retention and community building.

shared_context: Our development team has 10 members with varying skill sets.
We have a budget of $100,000 for the next sprint.
The new feature should be launched within the next 6 weeks.
